title: Occiput
summary: OC'CIPUT, noun [Latin ob and caput, head.] The hinder part of the head, or that part of the skull which forms the hind part of the head.

inlines.v: OC'CIPUT, noun [Latin ob and caput, head.] The hinder part of the head, or that part of the skull which forms the hind part of the head.
